cards.title: Cave In!
body: When this card enters play, destroy all Caverns, then this card deals each target 3 melee damage and destroys itself.

cards.title: Cave Spider
body: At the end of the environment turn, this card deals the non-environment target with the second highest HP 1 melee damage and 1 toxic damage. Reduce damage dealt by each target dealt damage this way by 1 until the start of the environment turn.

cards.title: Crystalline Chasm
body: When this card enters play, destroy all other Caverns. The first time each turn a hero card is discarded, that hero may deal 1 target 2 radiant damage. The first time each turn a villain card is discarded, the villain target with the highest HP deals each non-villain target 2 radiant damage.

cards.title: Gem Crawler
body: At the end of the environment turn, this card deals the character card with the highest HP 2 energy damage. Discard the top card of its deck.

cards.title: Hot Springs
body: When this card enters play, destroy all other Caverns. At the end of the environment turn, this card deals each target 1 fire damage. Each target not dealt damage this way gains 1 HP.

cards.title: Ice Chamber
body: When this card enters play, destroy all other Caverns. Increase all damage by 1. When 5 or more damage is dealt at once, search the environment deck and trash for a copy of Cave In! and put it into play, then shuffle the environment deck.

cards.title: Lost Digger
body: This card is immune to fire damage. At the end of the environment turn, one player may discard an equipment card. If they do, this card deals 1 target 2 fire damage. Otherwise, this card deals each hero with equipment cards in their hand 1 fire damage.

cards.title: The Heart of the Deep
body: Caverns are indestructible. At the start of the environment turn, this card deals the hero with the highest HP {H} radiant damage. At the end of the environment turn, play the top card of the environment deck.

cards.title: The Web
body: When this card enters play, destroy all other Caverns. Reduce damage dealt to Cave Spiders by 2. At the start of the environment turn, put all Cave Spiders from the environment trash into play.

cards.title: Twisting Passages
body: When this card enters play, shuffle the environment trash into the environment deck, then reveal cards from the top of the environment deck until a Cavern is revealed. Put it into play, then destroy this card.
cards.flavorText: "You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike."

cards.title: Underground Jungle
body: When this card enters play, destroy all other Caverns. At the end of the environment turn, reveal the top card of the environment deck. If it's a target, put it into play. Otherwise, discard it and this card deals the 3 targets with the highest HP 2 toxic damage each.
